content.short: Galactic Gecko Space Garage is an IP brand of 10,000 Space Racing Gecko NFTs run by GeckoDAO.
content.description: Galactic Gecko Space Garage is a Web3 hub for anyone who wants to network and learn about NFTs, trading, and crypto. It is a tight-knit community that offers a broad network of contacts and an engaging, collaborative atmosphere. Any Gecko NFT holder can volunteer to contribute to the project, gaining hands-on experience. Greenlisted, the investment affiliate linked to GeckoDAO, funds Web3 ventures that meet specific criteria, prioritizing projects that positively impact the ecosystem and elevate the space.
